name: Care 4 Me
source:
A short, silly furry VN about care and reciprocity with a pinch of existential horror! 

A college dropout returns home and gets trapped in a Tamagotchi-esque keychain right before her childhood best friend (and crush) shows up for a visit. 

[From [url=https://kittium.itch.io/care-4-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部搞怪无厘头的短篇兽人视觉小说，探讨关怀与互惠，还掺杂了一小撮存在主义恐怖！

一名大学辍学生回到家中，却在青梅竹马的挚友（兼暗恋对象）登门拜访的前一刻，意外被困进了一个类似拓麻歌子的电子宠物钥匙扣里。

[摘自[url=https://kittium.itch.io/care-4-me]itch.io[/url]]
